notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has power 3 or greater.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {U}, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {R}, returning Runic Repetition from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.
